{{Quote|I didn't realize they had names. What do they think about? They don't know what life is really like, and all they know is war, so they're probably perfectly happy. I'm glad they don't suffer.|Simi Noor, on clone troopers|<ref name="O66" />}}
'''Simi Noor''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Noor, lacking experience with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], did not know that the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] possessed informal names in addition to their assigned numerical designations and was surprised to learn the truth. Though Noor questioned what sorts of things the Republic's clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] thought about, the Padawan incorrectly believed that the clones did not suffer and were perfectly happy, as they had been created for war and knew no other life.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Simi Noor was mentioned in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="O66" />
